testsuite.name: io.github.skystrike.server.net.handlers.ChatRequestHandlerTest

testcase.name: a connection that never joined is ignored entirely
an ALL line is delivered to every joined player
a rejected line is delivered to nobody
a muted player's line reaches nobody, including themselves
a TEAM line never reaches the other team's connection
the author is the session, not the packet — there is no field to forge

testsuite.system-out: [chat] ALL <Nova> hello (3 recipients) [chat] drop player=1 reason=EMPTY [chat] drop player=1 reason=MUTED [chat] TEAM <Nova> rotating B (2 recipients) [chat] ALL <Nova> hi (3 recipients)
